place.name: Cabo da Roca
place.description: Cabo da Roca (Portuguese: [ˈkaβu dɐ ˈʁɔkɐ]) or Cape Roca is a cape which forms the westernmost point of the Sintra Mountain Range, of mainland Portugal, of continental Europe, and of the Eurasian landmass. It is located in the municipality of Sintra, near Azóia, to the west of Lisbon.
